rows.quote: We then leveraged the UK Biobank data to perform multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression, estimating the associations of single psychiatric disorder, co-occurring psychiatric disorder status and the weighted composite psychiatric disorder score with incident AD.

The only UK Biobank citation (ref 17, Sudlow 2015, p003) is a general cohort description and matches no dictionary row.
